items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: And his girlfriend, Loretta McDermott, had lived in New York

ctx.x: Century Theater. How much were you getting?

Well, we were getting $50, I think, a week. So, none of them were interested. We could have had all the gravy that the Dixieland Band got, because we were there before them, and we could have been hired before them. We could have worked the place. And, uh, I told them, well, we had a meeting. We talked it over, and I said, well, why don't we just go and take the job and wire Frisco? I said, we can pitch in, pitch in a couple of dollars a piece, and get Frisco up here to do that dance, that Frisco dance that he…
